directions.name: action and planning policies
directions.description: Learning policies that generate actions, subgoals and long-horizon plans in interactive environments. Hierarchical and goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, offline trajectory learning, Decision Transformers, and imitation learning for navigation, robot control and multi-agent pathfinding.

directions.name: world models and predictive control
directions.description: Learning action-conditioned environment dynamics and latent world models for model-based reinforcement learning, imagined rollouts and planning. State prediction and forecasting that improve control policies in non-stationary environments.

directions.name: language models assisting RL training
directions.description: Large language models help train reinforcement learning agents that act in environments: generating reward code, shaping trajectory rewards, temporal credit assignment, exploration and curriculum design, refining actions and improving external control policies.

directions.name: vision-language action policies
directions.description: Reinforcement learning and imitation learning train vision-language agents to execute multi-step actions in Android interfaces, games, embodied environments and robot control. Efficient exploration of action tokens and goal-directed sequential decisions.

directions.name: self-play for game policies
directions.description: Reinforcement learning agents learn action strategies for competitive games through self-play, opponent populations and league training, with policy improvement and long-horizon decision making.
